payload.summary: Implemented all 28 tasks across six work packages. The RPC probe now reaches the content-based path, the heavy generated JSON is declared unmergeable, and 2,762,479 bytes of analyzer cache moved to a new provenance local-cache tier. Verified on a real clean clone that absent local-cache artifacts report fresh rather than ARTIFACT_MISSING.
completed_work: wp-contracts: v2 provenance schema published, tier required and enumerated (26 tests)
wp-provenance: tier-aware check_freshness, new schema-version reason code, both version constants bumped (29 tests)
wp-rpc: get_server resolves repo_root, graph path resolved against the repository, reset_server seam (24 tests)
wp-merge-hygiene: four heavy JSON paths declared merge=binary, guarded against a future switch to union (8 tests)
wp-artifacts: three artifacts untracked and ignored, provenance regenerated at schema 2 (8 tests)
wp-integration: mirrors verified in sync, ruff clean, clean-clone freshness verified
Fixed three under-declared context-impact surfaces the gate caught in this change's own work-packages.yaml

decisions.title: A relative default graph path anchors at the module file, not the cwd
decisions.rationale: Design D4 said anchor `git rev-parse` at the directory containing the resolved graph path, but DEFAULT_GRAPH_PATH is relative, so that directory only exists by way of the cwd -- exactly what scenario .22 forbids. Following D4 literally would have satisfied the decision and violated the spec. A relative path now anchors at the module's own directory, also inside the repository being probed and also cwd-independent; an absolute path still anchors at its own directory.

decisions.title: A legacy-schema record emits both the version mismatch and PROVENANCE_INVALID
decisions.rationale: test_architecture_freshness.py::test_schema_invalid_provenance_is_drift writes {schema_version: 1} and asserts the codes intersect {PROVENANCE_INVALID, PROVENANCE_MISSING}. That file is in no package's write_allow and had to keep passing untouched. Emitting both is also simply truthful, and scenario .19's 'SHALL NOT report as artifact drift' is unaffected because neither is an artifact code.

decisions.title: Schema-version mismatch is checked before structural validation
decisions.rationale: _published_schema_path() can return None on a trimmed runtime copy. Checking the version independently of validate_provenance means the mismatch is still caught there, instead of going undetected entirely.

decisions.title: The refresh ran with PROJECT_CONTEXT_REPO_ID pinned
decisions.rationale: provenance.repository_id() derives identity from the git toplevel basename, which in a worktree is the change directory name. An unpinned run would have stamped 'fix-architecture-freshness-evidence' into a tracked artifact and produced a flip-flop on the next main-checkout refresh. The override is documented in that function's own docstring.

next_steps: Validation should confirm the merge train now selects tests rather than falling to full-suite every six hours.
The four open questions above are all follow-up candidates; none blocks this change.
